name: Taskbar Configurator
description: Compose native Windows taskbar styles, materials, visual states, layout and animations directly in MyWallpaper.

settings.label: Enable taskbar styling
settings.description: Turn this add-on's visual overrides on or off.

settings.label: Legacy fallback palette
settings.description: Only fills missing values from older configurations. Every saved control remains editable.

settings.label: Layout and position
settings.description: Change the existing taskbar content inside its Windows window. Other screen edges depend on Windows support.

settings.label: Taskbar width
settings.description: Content width follows the native XAML layout. Windows can still reserve empty space for widgets and the system tray.

settings.label: Custom width (px)
settings.description: Keep enough space for app buttons and the system tray; Windows clips content outside its taskbar window.

settings.label: Taskbar content alignment
settings.description: Moves the taskbar content, without changing the Windows screen edge or reserved work area.

settings.label: Content height (px · 0 = Windows)
settings.description: The taskbar window limits the usable height; this does not increase the reserved desktop area.

settings.label: Horizontal offset (px)
settings.description: Positive values move content right inside the native taskbar window.

settings.label: Vertical offset (px)
settings.description: Positive values move content down. Keep icons and flyouts inside the Windows taskbar area.

settings.label: App button height (px · 0 = Windows)
settings.description: Large values may be clipped by Windows; increase hover scale gradually.

settings.label: App button rotation (°)
settings.description: Composition rotation in degrees; the original angle is restored when disabled.

settings.label: Hover and press animations
settings.description: Animations run in Windows Composition when the pointer enters or presses a button; no polling loop.

settings.label: Compose your own rules
settings.description: Combine targets, materials, native visual states and layout. Guided editing and JSON use the same saved profile.

settings.label: Style rules
settings.description: Changes apply together. Leave this document empty to remove custom rules while keeping the other controls active. Native properties depend on the targeted Windows element; incompatible rules are reported in the add-on diagnostic log.
